title: Understanding Model Variance
text: When the training error increases but the validation error decreases, it suggests a change in the model's complexity. Think about how this affects the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Training vs. Validation Error
text: Consider what it means for a model to have a higher training error but a lower validation error. How does this relate to the model's ability to fit the training data versus new data?

title: Model Complexity and Variance
text: If a model's complexity is reduced, what happens to its variance?

title: Connecting Errors and Variance
text: A decrease in validation error with an increase in training error often indicates a reduction in overfitting. How does this relate to the model's variance?
